text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry, under the bridge~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Urara-senpai?
Why is she wearing sunglasses...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Is she heading under the overpass...?
...Now I'm curious.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man A
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I've received the goods fair and square.
Still, where in the world do you manage to
get your hands on such crazy stuff every time?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~ That's a secret!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Who is that guy... Sunglasses,
a spiked vest, and hair sticking up all spiky...
He looks super scary...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urara-senpai is acting weird too...
Could it be she got wrapped up
in something bad...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, jumping to conclusions is bad.
It's bad, but...
maybe I should investigate...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Justice Biko, deploying immediately!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, sorry to keep you waiting.
Here are the promised premium goods!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Th-This is some unbelievable stuff!
Hehehe, with this, my collection grows
even more impressive...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... No matter how I look at it,
this just seems like a shady deal...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the full story,
but I've gotta question those two first!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, storming in--

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh?
Wait? Why... won't my legs move...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be... Am I--scared...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm supposed to be an ally of justice... How pathetic of me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...No, a hero never runs away,
no matter how scared they are...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's how Carrotman did it too!
Facing down any terror head-on...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That... that is what a hero is!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Set your heart ablaze, Biko Pegasus!
Uwoooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's far enough!
Justice Biko has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here?!
I demand an explanation!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you've dragged Urara-senpai into some shady business...
Justice Biko will never forgive you!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
Shady business?! Y-You've got it all wrong!
We haven't done anything bad at all!
Right, Urara-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You see, we were just trading stickers!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ............Huh? Stickers?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The misters asked me to run an errand for them,
so I bought some cute stickers♪

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
If guys dressed like us went into the shop,
we'd end up scaring the kids, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan hangs out with guys like us without minding,
she's our best sticker buddy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
S-So that's what was going on...
Wait, then what about the sunglasses, Urara-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man B
text_block_list.text:
We told her to put them on.
Having a cute young miss standing around here
would make her stand out in a bad way.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Haha,
............Phew, what a relief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the evening, on my way back from running errands,
I spotted Biko Pegasus and Haru Urara in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We went and traded stickers! And then,
Biko-chan suddenly showed up with a BAM--

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
--And then, she went 'I won't forgive you!'
right at the misters.
Biko-chan was super cool!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Geez, that's embarrassing, Urara-senpai!
choice_data_list: Haha, sounds like you gave it your all, Biko!
Please rely on an adult next time.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Geez, that's embarrassing, Urara-senpai!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you worked really hard, Biko!
Whoa, you did your best, Biko!
Make sure to rely on adults in times like that.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! She did her very best
to protect me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan is totally my hero♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urara-senpai... thank you!
Ah, I'm so glad I gave it my all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
I had it in my head that I had to do it all alone.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Helping your allies is what makes a true hero, after all!
Next time, I'll think things through more carefully!
